disposition: Do not adopt. Snakes regressed in every pair; Sky Force did not improve consistently. Production compiler and deployment are unchanged. Preserve implementation and tests as a reproducible patch, without adding another runtime option.

plan.hypothesis: Sharing scalar page proofs with aligned block and span accesses bypasses redundant TLB hash/tag/permission loads in generic ARM code.
plan.decision_rule: Exact replays and faults required. Serial ABBA per game, useful roughly 3 percent throughput gain repeated in both pairs. One BAAB confirmation if mixed. Pool all observations. No owned build/test/profile overlaps timing.

limits: Shared host; outside activity uncontrolled. No owned build, test, profiler or parallel benchmark overlapped throughput runs. All 16 completed observations retained.
The native instruction counts describe one successful translation path, not cycles or whole-loop cost. TurboFan was forced for native inspection; timing used ordinary Chromium tiering.
The full legacy suite was stopped during its exhaustive bounded-execution matrix after focused memory and fault checks passed. No full-suite pass is claimed.

The independent compiler cleanup advanced trunk to 95ba2f4d6 during the experiment. Both measured binaries used the frozen f6bc17a18 source and matching frontend. No comparison across cleanup revisions is used.
The negative adoption decision is based on whole-game timings. Larger generated code and added miss checks are observed costs, but their individual causal contributions were not isolated.
